policy.description: Deep NLP outputs may create review packets, rankings, and warnings only. They must not certify, approve, or directly ship learner-facing card content.

licenseUse.notes: Registered as a candidate JavaScript inference runtime. No model output is active until package version, lockfile, model license, local model integrity, and deterministic runtime policy are pinned.
Registered as a candidate pinned local-model runtime. No ONNX model output is active until model artifact integrity, runtime version, and reproducibility checks are tracked.
Registered as a candidate Japanese tokenizer. Tokenization output may support model features and review packets only after dictionary files and package version are pinned.

origin.notes: Optional future worker boundary for models that are not practical in JavaScript. The Node pipeline remains the contract owner.
